**“Best” – a moving target** In football “the best player” is always debated – different people weigh trophies, statistics, influence on games, consistency over seasons, and even personality differently. Below is a snapshot of how the sport’s biggest voices (FIFA‑FIFPRO voting, UEFA Champions League stats, club success, media consensus) see the field **as of mid‑May 2026**. | Rank | Player | Club (2025‑26) | Key Stats & Highlights | |------|--------|-----------------|--------------------------------| | **1️⃣** | **Erling Haaland** | Manchester City | • 34 league goals + 12 Champions League goals last season.
• Scored 50+ goals across all competitions this campaign.
• Led England to Euro 2024 semi‑finals, winning Golden Boot.
• Named Premier League Golden Boots (twice), PFA Players’ Player of the Year (2025). | | **2️⃣** | **Kylian Mbappé** | Paris Saint‑Germain / Al‑Jazira (loan) | • 28 Ligue 1 goals, 10 assists in 2025‑26.
• Won French Super Cup, Coupe de France, and reached UCL quarter‑finals.
• Awarded FIFA Men’s Player of the Year (2025).
• Continues to break records for fastest hat‑trick, youngest scorer in multiple tournaments. | | **3️⃣** | **Kevin De Bruyne** | Manchester City | • 15 assists, 5 goals in Premier League; 11 assists in UCL.
• Voted UEFA Midfielder of the Season twice.
• Integral to City’s treble run (Premier League, FA Cup, UCL). | | **4️⃣** | **Robert Lewandowski** | FC Barcelona | • 22 La Liga goals, 8 assists; 14 UCL goals.
• First Polish player to score >30 goals in a single European domestic season since 1990s.
• Winner of Spanish Footballer of the Year (2025). | | **5️⃣** | **Harry Kane** | Tottenham Hotspur | • 20 Premier League goals, 13 assists.
• Helped Spurs reach Europa Conference League final.
• Recognised as England’s captain and key playmaker. | ### Why Haaland tops many lists today * **Goal‑scoring rate:** Over 1 goal per game across all competitions in both 2024‑25 and 2025‑26 seasons—an unprecedented strike rate for a modern forward. * **Versatility:** Works equally well inside out from the front line or dropping deep into midfield. * **Impact factor:** His presence alone changes tactics; opponents build entire defensive plans around him. ### Other contenders * **Cristiano Ronaldo** – Still producing at elite level for Saudi Pro League side Al‑Nassr, yet age (39+) limits long‑term dominance. * **Mohamed Salah** – Consistent performer for Liverpool, especially in attacking midfield roles. * **Vinícius Jr.** – Emerging talent showing flashes of brilliance for Barcelona and Brazil national team. --- #### Bottom Line If you’re looking for *who dominates the pitch week‑in, week‑out*, **Erling Haaland** is the clear choice for 2026. If you prefer a blend of experience, leadership, and consistent excellence, **Kylian Mbappé** and **Kevin De Bruyne** follow closely behind. Ultimately, the title of “best” depends on whether you prioritize raw numbers, tactical impact, or overall contribution to your team’s successes.
